items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: We were starting to be in love with each other.

ctx.x: My engagement at the Chikito was to finish at the end of February 1950 and we were now within a few days from closing. The night of the 23rd a sweet looking Swiss girl was sitting in the balcony of the place. The Chikito was built in a circular form with a balcony that went around the place and the dance floor was down a floor below with tables around. There were tables in the balcony also and as I came by one of the tables going down stairs toget on the band-stand, this sweet looking Swiss girl asked me for an…

She came the day after and we got along very well between the little French that I spoke and making signs with out hands. She told me that her name was Lily, that she was Swiss and that she was a jazz fan although she didn't know too much about jazz musicians at the time. She had come a few times to the Chikito and was crazy about the band.

We met a couple of times after that and I managed to make her understood that when I finished my contract at the Chikito, I would play a concert in Olten an the 3rd of March with Buck Clayton. As Olten was not far from the place where she lived, she say she would come to the concert.
